description: A single arithmetic block: two inputs, a choice of around 200 algorithms and a constant for the algorithm to work with.

params.text: Picks the algorithm applied to the block's two inputs and its constant; touch the display and drag up or down to change it.
Sets the constant C the chosen algorithm works with, -100 to +100.

inputs.text: The X value the algorithm works on; with no algorithm picked it passes straight to the output.
The Y value the algorithm works on.

outputs.text: The result of the algorithm; with no algorithm picked it carries the X input.

notes: with no algorithm chosen the module passes the X input straight to the output; choose one by dragging up or down on the algorithm display, or by right-clicking it.
right-clicking an algorithm display gives Copy and Paste for that one algorithm, then a submenu for each category: Pass through, Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication and the rest.
menu: Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
